About The Awards

India's newest platform for honouring leaders redefining business success.

Presented by Financial Express — India's trusted voice in business journalism for over six decades — the Awards bring together CEOs, founders and institutions across eleven categories, judged by a panel of India's most respected business minds.

With a reach spanning print, digital, social and live events, Financial Express engages leaders, policymakers and investors across every sector. The Leadership Awards extend that legacy: recognising teams inspired, resilience built, and results delivered with a larger mission in mind.

TVS Motor Company Sponsor

World's third largest two- and three-wheeler manufacturer, headquartered in Chennai.

TVS Motor Company (BSE: 532343, NSE: TVSMOTOR) is the world's third largest automaker in the two- and three-wheeler segment, focused on mobility solutions that are exciting, responsible, sustainable and safe. Headquartered in Chennai, the company is known for high-quality, high-value-for-money products, with more than 63 million customers riding a TVS vehicle worldwide.

TVS Motor's strength lies in its extensive research and development, and it operates a nationwide network of over 3,500 certified touch-points across four manufacturing facilities in India and Indonesia. Group companies include Norton Motorcycles in the UK and TVS e-bike Company AG in Switzerland. It was the first two-wheeler manufacturer to win the Deming Prize for quality excellence, and has ranked No. 1 in the J.D. Power Customer Service Satisfaction Survey.

Established in 1961, Financial Express is the business daily from the Indian Express Group. In the business media space, the publication stands for credibility and insightful coverage of both national and international economic issues. In short, if you have read it in Financial Express, it is factual. The publication doesn’t just disseminate information, it goes much beyond to explain how it impacts you. The information, analysis and knowledge that Financial Express unfolds in its pages empower the reader with informative reading that makes for leading-edge financial decisions. Explains why, it is a preferred choice of thinkers and business leaders. Thought leadership is what Financial Express is all about.
